name: Black Iron Dove Cage
blurb: A domed cage of black wrought iron with a white dove cooing on its swing, hung or stood in a sunny window.

era.note: A wrought-iron bird cage with a dove; plain pet furnishing, no creature or expansion theme. Art is from the later decor block; the release date is unverified.

implNote: one tile per facing; the hue tints the bird only (partially hueable)
